item: the Host guard no longer serves the test client's name (testserver): one allow-set feeds the Host guard and the Origin check, and the suite lists the name through OO_ALLOWED_HOSTS (audit 0.5.0)
summary: The Host-header guard answered 421 to every name but the loopback ones and the operator's OO_ALLOWED_HOSTS, except Starlette's TestClient name, testserver, which was served in the shipped app on the reasoning that the client never opens a socket. testserver is a single-label name nobody owns, and a name resolution that is not DNS (LLMNR, NetBIOS) is answered by whoever answers first on a LAN: a same-LAN attacker could answer it, lure the user to http://testserver:8000 and rebind it to 127.0.0.1, and the page would be same-origin with the API and pass the Host guard (the CSRF middleware already refused it as an Origin). Read from the code, not reproduced. It is now served by nobody by default: one _allowed_hosts() (the loopback names and OO_ALLOWED_HOSTS) feeds both checks, tests/conftest.py appends testserver to OO_ALLOWED_HOSTS for the suite (an operator's own value in the shell is kept), and the two in-process operator tools (the scale bench's endpoint phase and scripts/perf_harness.py) build their TestClient on http://127.0.0.1. Pinned: without the variable testserver is refused as a Host (421, with or without a port, in any case), the loopback names are still served, with the variable set it is served like any listed name, and a state-changing request naming it as its Host or Origin is refused (403: that part already held, the Origin check never served the name, and the test keeps it from coming back); the scale bench's endpoint phase is run against the real app without the variable (200) and perf_harness is pinned by reading its source. Not browser-verified. Run against the new default: the 515 files under tests/ whose text names TestClient, a client fixture or /api/ (10,843 passed; 15 tests failed there and two modules did not import, because scipy and vaderSentiment are not installed in the sandbox and one file depends on the order of the files before it, every one failing the same way on the commit before this change), and, independently, the 270 files that use TestClient with OO_ALLOWED_HOSTS unset in the shell (4,580 passed, the same 13 scipy 404s as the parent, no 421).
